accessed_api_types.local_only_justification: The migration path reads app-owned legacy SwiftData sidecar file metadata through FileManager.attributesOfItem(atPath:) to detect and remove empty migrated files. The path is local/app-group storage only; no derived file metadata is sent off-device.
